en: Black‑and‑white view from a gently winding hillside road with a wooden railing, where a boy in old-fashioned clothing is standing and facing the camera. To the left is a steep, tree‑covered hill with a villa or small manor house visible among the trees. In the valley and plain beyond, there is a town with church spires and scattered houses, and low hills on the distant horizon. A stone wall and a single utility pole stand on the right side of the road. There is no visible printed text or caption on the image itself.
